title: Points Held Back for Goods Coming Back on a Circle Release
content:
## Points held back for goods coming back

Where the profile holds a return authorisation under Northbeam Returns and Restocking, points on a Northbeam
Circle Membership are held back against what that return leaves the member owing.

1. Where the return authorisation the profile holds stands inspected or settled and a restocking fee stands
   outstanding on it, the points held back for goods coming back are that outstanding restocking fee taken at
   the tier's value per hundred points.
2. Where that return stands received or in transit and no restocking fee stands outstanding on it, the points
   held back for goods coming back are the purchase price recorded on it taken at the same rate.
3. Where neither of those holds, no points are held back for goods coming back, and 0 points are taken off on
   this account.

## Reading money as points at the tier's rate

The money is converted at the tier's value per hundred points: the amount is divided by that value and the
figure taken times one hundred, giving a whole number of points rounded to the nearest point.

| Tier | Value of 100 points (USD) | Points a hypothetical 38.50 outstanding holds back |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.50 | 7700 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 0.75 | 5133 |
| Circle Total Annual | 1.00 | 3850 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 1.00 | 3850 |
| Circle Business Pro | 1.10 | 3500 |
| Circle Business Elite | 1.25 | 3080 |

## Cases

A return standing settled with a restocking fee of 38.50 outstanding, held by a member on Circle Total
Household Annual, holds back 3850 points. The same return with no restocking fee outstanding holds back
nothing on this account, because the second reading applies only to a return standing received or in transit.
A return standing in transit with no restocking fee outstanding holds back the purchase price recorded on it
at the same rate — 6160 points on a hypothetical purchase price of 61.60 on that tier.
